title: topic selection preflight: nontrivial structure gates
notes: Controller-only preflight for selecting a mechanism_loop portfolio. These cases are not a full explorer run and must not be promoted directly. They test whether candidate topics have a non-obvious structural knob and a plausible consumer beyond rule smoke.

cases.variant: B/S covers goal and sweeps a remote crate row
cases.changedVariable: remote crate sits on the row that changes side after the anchor covers the target
cases.question: Can an anchor-as-target move also consume a remote material row, making target cover a boundary endpoint selector?

cases.variant: B/S covers goal but remote crate stays on box side
cases.changedVariable: same target-cover move, but the remote crate is one row above the swept boundary
cases.question: If target cover alone is the whole story, remote row placement should not change material output.

cases.variant: vertical B/S pull sweeps a sticky blocker
cases.changedVariable: the lower half target cell contains a sticky block that is movable in the same sweep direction
cases.question: Does a sticky blocker become a movable side resource during pull extraction, rather than a simple wall-like blocker?

cases.variant: vertical B/S pull side target is a wall
cases.changedVariable: replace the sticky blocker with a wall in the same side target cell
cases.question: Wall in the lower half target cell should close the footprint gate.

cases.variant: vertical B/S pull side target is empty
cases.question: Empty side target isolates the blocker material effect from the base footprint movement.

cases.changedVariable: baseline: the reverse-force handle cell is empty after the first sticky push
cases.question: Empty handle cell gives the player a direct reverse push interface after the sticky footprint passes the mouth.

cases.changedVariable: replace the empty handle cell with a crate and give it a one-cell clearing pocket
cases.question: A crate in the handle cell turns the reverse interface into a clear-then-push resource handoff instead of simply closing the gate.

cases.changedVariable: replace the occupied handle cell with a wall while keeping the first sticky push legal
cases.question: A wall in the same handle cell closes the reverse interface and distinguishes movable occupancy from hard closure.
